meta.title: The workshop: how Lit Neon signs are made in the UK | Lit Neon
meta.description: Every Lit Neon sign is drawn, bent, mounted and tested in a UK workshop, with a drawing you approve first, a 3-year warranty and free mainland-GB delivery.
meta.ogTitle: Made in a UK workshop | Lit Neon
meta.ogDescription: Drawn, bent, mounted and tested in a UK workshop, with a drawing you approve first.

about.lede: We draw, bend and test LED neon signs to order. You see the drawing before we make anything, and when you get in touch you talk to the people who make it.
about.sheetCaption: This is what you approve: a drawing of your words at the real size, before anything is made.
about.processLede: Five chapters, illustrated with your own words. Real workshop film joins them as it is shot.
about.makeEyebrow: What we make, and what we don't
make: Indoor LED neon signs on cut acrylic, in your words or ours
Logos and artwork, redrawn as tube by a designer after a free mockup
Ready-made designs in 12 tube colours and five sizes
Outdoor signs and anything over 2 metres, quoted by hand
dont: Glass neon: it's fragile, high voltage and a specialist's craft
Imported signs sold on under our name
Anything we haven't drawn for you to approve first
about.glassLink: LED or glass? Our honest comparison
about.promisesEyebrow: What you can hold us to

promises.title: Drawing first
promises.body: A designer draws your sign at its real size. Nothing is made until you approve it, and changes before then are free.

promises.title: {warranty}
promises.body: LEDs, power supply, dimmer and remote, under normal indoor use. Your statutory rights are not affected.

promises.title: {lead}
promises.body: Counted from the day you approve the drawing, skipping weekends and bank holidays.

promises.title: Free delivery
promises.body: Tracked, across mainland GB, with the dimmer, remote and a UK plug in the box.

about.contactCta: Talk to the people who make it
about.finalBody: Type them in the designer and watch the price as you go, or send a logo for a free mockup.
